registrations.packaging: Clear Glass Ampoule x 10 mL Box of 5's

summary: Tracutil (B. Braun Melsungen AG) is a concentrated trace element solution added to parenteral nutrition for adults. Philippine registration: 10 ml glass ampoules, box of 5.
composition_notes: Sodium 147 micromol (3.4 mg) per ampoule (SmPC). Source is the UK SmPC (text revised December 11, 2013).
dosing_limits: Adults: 10 ml (one ampoule) daily for basal needs; up to 20 ml with monitoring of trace element status when needs are moderately increased (SmPC 4.2).
kidney_notes: Use with caution in impaired renal function: excretion of selenium, fluoride, chromium, molybdenum and zinc may be significantly decreased (SmPC 4.4).

Contraindicated in pronounced cholestasis, Wilson's disease, iron storage disorders, and in neonates, infants and children (SmPC 4.3). Monitor manganese levels in prolonged nutrition and serum ferritin at regular intervals (SmPC 4.4).
guideline_heading: How it fits the ESPEN 2021 kidney nutrition guideline
guideline: ESPEN 2021 Recommendation 22: "Because of increased requirements during KF and critical illness, and large effluent losses during KRT, trace elements should be monitored and supplemented. Increased attention should be given to selenium, zinc, and copper." Grade of recommendation B – Strong consensus (100% agreement).
bottom_line: ESPEN asks for trace elements to be monitored and supplemented in kidney failure and KRT, with attention to selenium, zinc and copper; at the same time, the SmPC warns that several elements accumulate when renal excretion is reduced. Give the basal dose and adjust to measured levels.
